subject: Vendor intake: LatticeBio security review (SOC 2 / SIG / CAIQ)
content:
From: Emma Li <emma@latticebio.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-06T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Vendor security intake: SOC 2 / SIG / CAIQ requests

Hi Sofia,

We're kicking off a vendor security review at LatticeBio as part of our procurement for an upcoming project. Can we book a 30-minute intake call next week to walk through Redwood's SOC 2 scope and CAIQ/SIG answers? On that call we'll (1) confirm which artifacts you can share, (2) get an owner for each evidence item, and (3) agree on a delivery timeline.

Our preferred windows (PST): Tuesday 12/8 9:00-11:00, Wednesday 12/9 13:00-15:00, or Friday 12/11 10:00-12:00. If none work, please propose alternatives.

We will need:
- CAIQ or SIG questionnaire answers (spreadsheet preferred)
- SOC 2 report (or link to download / attestation)
- Network diagram / infra ownership
- Encryption-in-transit and at-rest details + KMS provider
- Data retention and log retention policies
- Evidence samples (redacted logs, config snippets, vulnerability scan report)

I've attached our vendor intake form and our security point-of-contact is CISO Ana Morales (ana.morales@latticebio.com).

Thanks,
Emma
---
Emma Li
Vendor Risk Manager | LatticeBio
[Attachment: lattice_vendor_form.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Emma Li <emma@latticebio.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-06T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Vendor security intake: SOC 2 / SIG / CAIQ requests

Hi Emma — thanks for the note and the intake form. We can definitely do a 30-minute intake. Tuesday 12/8 at 9:30 PST works for our team; I've provisionally booked that on the calendar (invite to follow).

Quick answers up front so you can prep:
- We maintain a current SOC 2 Type II report; we'll share a download link with you after a short access verification.
- We have a completed CAIQ draft we can walk through and then provide a spreadsheet export.
- Evidence owners:
  • Karthik Iyer — architecture diagrams, network segmentation, infra maps
  • Aditya Rao — runtime logs, KV cache disposition, quantization/runtime infra
  • Marissa Cole — contract, data processing agreement, and customer onboarding artifacts

I've attached a provisional evidence index and a draft meeting agenda. During the call we'll align on redaction rules and what can be provided as "sample" vs full reports.

Sofia Ivanova
Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference

Date: 2026-12-08T16:24:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Vendor security intake: SOC 2 / SIG / CAIQ requests

Sofia / Marissa — Confirmed for 9:30am PST tomorrow (12/8). One clarification ahead of the call: our security team expects a short write-up about how you handle encryption key lifecycle (KMS provider, rotation cadence, separation of privileges) and whether customer-scoped keys (BYOK) are supported in Dedicated/Private deployments. We also need to know your default log retention and whether logs are redacted by default for PII. If you can drop those two items into the CAIQ workbook or attach as a one-page summary before the call, that would save time.

Also, we prefer to receive SOC 2 via a secure download link and an NDA is fine — we'll have that signed before access is granted.

Thanks — see you tomorrow.
